editorial.blurb: Gorilla Sushi delivers exceptional sushi quality at remarkably affordable prices, with staff so attentive and a kitchen so fast that even during thunderstorms, diners leave happy.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive knowing their sample plates are just $3.95 and the Scallop Shooter is a must-order; if you're not a sushi purist, the fried calamari and gyoza are equally fantastic.

topDishes.note: Extra fantastic, a standout signature dish
Highly recommended alongside gyoza and cucumber salad
